architecture: Separate raw imported data, formula/calculation areas, model/report outputs, and configuration assumptions. Choose Excel features based on edition support and keep high-impact assumptions visible.
implementation_plan: Complete project objective: Reduce repetitive work involved in generating periodic reports.
Implement and test feature: Refreshable data and calculated summaries
Implement and test feature: Automated formatting and report generation
Implement and test feature: Error handling and execution procedure
Implement and test feature: Choose VBA or Office Scripts/Power Automate by environment
Keep a pristine copy of the raw input data.
Independently verify representative totals/calculations and test edge cases.
Record Excel version, external connections, permissions, refresh procedure, backup/recovery and limitations.
reference_approach: Use the linked starter brief and synthetic datasets as input. The exact finished workbook depends on the learner’s layout and business assumptions, so review the acceptance criteria and expected results rather than treating a single workbook design as universal.
acceptance_review: Every required feature can be demonstrated from a fresh test copy.
Key totals/results reconcile to source records and at least two calculations are checked independently.
Blank, duplicate, invalid or threshold-boundary inputs are tested where relevant.
Keyboard access, readable labels, chart descriptions and number formats are checked.
Setup, assumptions, refresh, security, compatibility, and known limitations are documented.
explanation: Protected review plan for the project; it is not a completed workbook and is not a claim that the project has been executed or deployed.
